description: Visual Studio generated an App Installer file that ignored the desired update settings until a Package.appinstaller template was added, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/67285329/how-do-i-get-the-msix-appinstaller-to-output-the-correct-settings-during-each-bu.
prompt: Every publish regenerates my MSIX `.appinstaller` file with the wrong update settings. I want launch checks to prompt, block activation, run the background task, and allow forced upgrades/downgrades without hand-editing the output after each build.
